story_text: As a staff member, I want to confirm a booking so that the guest knows their reservation is secured.

positive.title: Confirm a booking with a valid booking ID as staff
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit
positive.expected_result: The booking's status is changed successfully

positive.title: Confirmed booking status reflects the change
steps: 1. Navigate to the get specific booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit
positive.expected_result: The booking's status is changed successfully

negative.title: Confirm a booking as a guest (unauthorized)
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the user's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit

negative.title: Confirm a booking with a non-existent ID
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID of an non-existent booking to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit
negative.expected_result: An error message stating that no booking found for this ID

negative.title: Confirm a booking with an invalid ID format
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add an invalid booking ID format to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit
negative.expected_result: An error message stating that no booking found for this ID

negative.title: Confirm an already confirmed booking
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
4. Click submit
3. Clcik submit again
negative.expected_result: An error message stating that no booking found for this ID

edge.title: Confirm a booking that has already been cancelled
steps: 1. Navigate to the cancel booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
3. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
4. Using the staff's token, add the same booking ID to the edpoint
5. Clcik submit
edge.expected_result: An error message stating that no booking found for this ID

edge.title: Confirm a booking whose check-in date is today
steps: 1. Navigate to the confirm booking endpoint
2. Using the staff's token, add a booking ID to the edpoint
3. Clcik submit
edge.expected_result: The booking's status is changed successfully
